Male flowers 4-merous; tepals free; anthers extrorse to laterally dehiscent, filaments inflexed or straight in bud; pistillode subulate or absent. Female flowers sessile, free or connate proximally; tepals 4, decussate, free or fused to the middle; ovary free or sunken in sockets of the receptacle; stigmatic arms 1−2, short or long. Fruits simple, drupaceous, very thinly pulpy, enclosed in the fleshy perianth, mostly not projecting, often concrescent below into a fleshy syncarp. In Sabah one species, M. cochinchinensis (Lour.) Corner, very rare, known only by one collection, J.H. Beaman 7932, from Mt. Kinabalu.
